newsitem.title: USA: Boston Group LP gets capital infusion.
newsitem.headline: Boston Group LP gets capital infusion.

text.p: Boston Group LP said it reached preliminary agreements for the infusion of additional capital and expects to resume full operations this week subject to closing of the deals.

Under the preliminary agreements a group of investors, including Joseph Salvani, will buy an equity stake in the Boston Group and Wexford Management LLC will provide capital in the form of subordinated debt.
The transaction requires definitive agreements, due diligence and regulatory approval.
Boston Group failed to meet its capital requirement last week, forcing it to halt normal business.
